dedupe_keys.name: certs microgrid test bed demonstration data

description: This data set holds the recorded waveforms from the CERTS Microgrid Test Bed demonstration, a field test of microgrid concepts hosted by American Electric Power. It was published in 2022 on Figshare+ by Ciaran Roberts, Joseph Eto, Robert Lasseter, David Klapp, Amrit Khalsa, Benjamin Schenkman, Mahesh Illindala and Surya Baktiono. The demonstration aimed to make it easier to integrate small generators into microgrids by testing three techniques: automatic transition without interruption between grid-connected and islanded modes; protection that does not depend on high fault currents; and control that keeps voltage and frequency stable in island mode without high-speed communications. Data are grouped by project phase, each with a spreadsheet logging the test set-up, comments and data folder. Each test's waveforms are a Parquet file with nanosecond timestamps, event trigger times, three-phase instantaneous voltages as a percentage of nominal, and phase currents in amps, recorded from about 0.25 seconds before to 5 seconds after each trigger. Coverage is one test site. Files are about 9.6 GB, downloadable from Figshare+ under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: non-commercial licence, and timestamps have no time zone. Simulation uses are validating microgrid islanding, protection and resilience models. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
